title: Observability: KV cache health dashboard + alerts in observability-pack
creator: Allison Grant
body:
## Context
We’re rolling out KV cache compaction behind a runtime flag. SRE needs a single dashboard to:
- Detect fragmentation/allocator thrash before it turns into p95/p99 spikes or OOM-prevented admission control.
- Attribute tail latency to allocation failures, eviction rate, and compaction overhead.
- Validate canary coverage (compaction_enabled true vs false) by region/pool/model_family.

Spec is here (source of truth for layout + PromQL):
- confluence://eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/kv-cache-health-dashboard-spec

Related runtime metrics work:
- Linear: ENG-2842 (metric names/labels)
- GitHub: PR-18423 (runtime metrics + structured logging)

## Scope
Implement the KV cache health dashboard and initial alert rules in the observability-pack repo.

Deliverables:
1) Grafana dashboard JSON (single-page layout with variables: deployment_mode/region/pool/model_family/compaction_enabled/window).
2) Alert rules (Grafana-managed) matching the spec:
   - Fragmentation critical per pool
   - Allocation failures elevated per pool
   - p99 regression + fragmentation correlated
   - Compaction overhead risk (GPU time p99)
   - Compaction thrash (run frequency)
3) Drill-down links:
   - Runbook link: confluence://eng-sre/runbooks/mitigating-kv-cache-fragmentation-incidents
   - Logs explorer link template: filter region/pool and message contains kv_compaction or kv_evict

Non-goals:
- Creating a separate per-pool detail dashboard (optional follow-up if needed).
- Changing runtime metric semantics/labels (block on ENG-2842 if mismatched).

## Implementation notes
- All KV cache metrics must include at least: region, pool, deployment_mode, model_family.
- compaction_enabled must be available as a label or derived dimension in dashboards (if this ends up being a runtime_build-only split, call it out explicitly).
- Prefer summed histograms by (le, pool) before histogram_quantile (avoid per-instance quantile noise).

## Acceptance criteria
- From top row, oncall can answer in <2 minutes:
  1) Is p99 spiking in a specific pool/region?
  2) Is fragmentation rising and allocator search time/failures increasing?
  3) Are evictions/compaction responsible, and what’s the overhead?
- Dashboard works for Hosted and Dedicated pools (deployment_mode variable).
- Alert rules are routed with the intended severities (page vs ticket) and include pool/region in the notification payload.

## Rollout plan
- Land dashboard + alerts in observability-pack behind a folder/tag for runtime-1.18.
- Deploy to staging Grafana, validate queries return data in at least one hosted pool.
- Enable alerts initially in “no page” mode (ticket/notify only) for 48h to tune thresholds with SRE.
- Flip paging for Alert 1 (fragmentation critical) + Alert 2 (alloc failures elevated) once false-positive rate looks acceptable.

## Links
- Spec: confluence://eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/kv-cache-health-dashboard-spec
- SLO guidance: confluence://eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/hosted-runtime-tail-latency-slo-fragmentation-signals
- Runbook: confluence://eng-sre/runbooks/mitigating-kv-cache-fragmentation-incidents
- Planned implementation PR: github://observability-pack/pr-521

## Open questions
1) Do we have compaction_enabled exposed as a metric label consistently, or do we need to join on a config-export metric? (If not available, we can approximate with runtime_build for canary pools, but it’s weaker.)
2) Dedicated routing: for dedicated pools, do we want paging only when paired with p99 regression (to reduce noise), or page on alloc failures alone?
comments: 2025-03-06 (Allison Grant): Created per canary readiness checklist. Please follow the spec exactly for variable names so SRE can reuse saved views. Blocked on ENG-2842 for final metric names/labels.

2025-03-07 (Caleb Johnson): Started dashboard JSON in observability-pack. Most panels wired; waiting on final metric name for allocator search histogram (currently using runtime_kv_cache_allocator_search_us_bucket from the spec).

2025-03-08 (Rafael Mendes): For Alert 2 (alloc failures), suggest two severities: page only if failures > 0.5/s AND p99 > baseline+25%. Otherwise ticket. Dedicated: ticket-only unless paired with timeouts.

2025-03-10 (Omar El-Sayed): Confirmed fragmentation ratio definition matches runtime implementation in PR-18423. Please add an annotation overlay for compaction runs if we can derive from runtime_kv_cache_compaction_runs_total (even without logs).

2025-03-11 (Aisha Bello): Add a topk table by (region,pool,model_family) for alloc failures and timeouts to speed triage. Also add a text panel with threshold guidance (good/monitor/degraded/critical).

2025-03-12 (Caleb Johnson): PR up: github://observability-pack/pr-521. Includes dashboard + 5 alert rules defaulting to ticket/notify (paging disabled). Needs review from SRE for routing and thresholds before enabling paging.
